requirements.title: Writing the render with every save
requirements.rationale: A render written by a separate step is a render someone forgets; written by the save, it cannot fall behind the artifacts it is derived from.

criteria.condition: a package is written to disk through the library, by Save, by Transition or by Supersede
criteria.action: write spec.md in the package directory in the same all-or-nothing write as the other artifacts
criteria.contract: after the call the directory holds spec.md whose bytes are the package's render; spec.md is written to a temporary file and fsynced in the same phase as prd.md and the three JSON artifacts, and renamed into place in the same phase as they are

setup: a package directory on disk holding a complete package and no spec.md
check.pseudocode: table in afspec/afspec_test.go, beside the other Save tests: for each writer case — dir = fixture package copied into t.TempDir(); spec = LoadSpec(dir); spec.Status = case.status; call case.write(spec, dir); assert readFile(dir+"/spec.md") == expectedRenderedBytes(resultingSpec); assert no glob match dir+"/*.tmp.*"

criteria.action: for any package, compose spec.md as one header line, a blank line, and then the package's whole combined render with no scope and no budget
criteria.contract: the first line is exactly "<!-- Generated by afspec from prd.md, requirements.json, test_spec.json, tasks.json and architecture.md. Do not edit: change those files, or run speca <package> --render. -->", the second line is empty, and the bytes from the third line on are byte-identical to what specr <package> returns in result.markdown with no --task, no --section and no --max-tokens

setup: a package held in memory, once with an architecture and once without
check.pseudocode: in afspec/render_test.go: b = spec.RenderedBytes(); lines = split(b, "\n"); assert lines[0] == header; assert lines[1] == ""; assert join(lines[2:], "\n") == spec.RenderCombined(); assert RenderedFileName == "spec.md"; then Save into a temp dir and assert the file on disk equals b

criteria.action: for any package, produce the same spec.md bytes on every composition of it, taking nothing from the clock, the environment, the file system or map iteration order
criteria.contract: two compositions of one package compare equal byte for byte, and the bytes hold no timestamp other than the created_at and updated_at the PRD frontmatter already carries

setup: three packages: an empty scaffold, a full package, and a package with an architecture
check.pseudocode: in afspec/render_test.go, beside TestRender_IsDeterministic: for each fixture — a = spec.RenderedBytes(); b = spec.RenderedBytes(); assert a == b; reloaded = LoadSpec(dir); assert reloaded.RenderedBytes() == a; assert the only RFC 3339 instants in a are spec.CreatedAt and spec.UpdatedAt

criteria.condition: a save cannot write its temporary files, for example because the package directory is not writable
criteria.action: return a save error, leave every artifact file of the package as it was, and write no spec.md
criteria.contract: the call returns a *SaveError; prd.md, requirements.json, test_spec.json, tasks.json and architecture.md are byte-identical to before the call; spec.md is absent if it was absent and byte-identical to before if it was there; and no file matching *.tmp.* is left in the directory

setup: a package directory holding a complete package, run once with no spec.md in it and once with a spec.md whose bytes are known
the directory made unwritable, so that creating a temporary file in it fails
check.pseudocode: in afspec/afspec_test.go, beside TestSave_LeavesNoTempFiles: before = hashEveryFile(dir); chmod(dir, 0o500) and skip when the test runs as root; err = spec.Save(dir); assert errors.As(err, &*afspec.SaveError); chmod back; assert hashEveryFile(dir) == before; assert no glob match dir+"/*.tmp.*"

criteria.action: expose, as exported identifiers, the name of the rendered file and the exact bytes it must hold for a given package, so that a program which writes a package's files itself writes the same spec.md
criteria.contract: an exported constant gives the file name spec.md, and an exported method on the package type returns the bytes of 15-REQ-1.2; a file written from them is byte-identical to the spec.md a save of the same package writes

criteria.action: for any package directory that holds a spec.md, read none of its bytes into the loaded package
criteria.contract: the package loaded from a directory holding spec.md compares equal, field for field, with the package loaded from the same directory with spec.md removed, and no field of it carries the file's bytes

setup: one package directory copied twice: in one copy a spec.md holding the package's render, and in the other a spec.md holding unrelated text; a third copy with no spec.md at all
check.pseudocode: in afspec/afspec_test.go, beside TestLoadSpec_ReadsArchitectureOnlyWhenPresent: for each case — write the case's spec.md, s = LoadSpec(dir), s.Dir = ""; assert reflect.DeepEqual against the copy with no spec.md; assert the rendered-file text does not appear in s.PRDBody or s.Architecture

requirements.title: The rendered rule in the verdict
requirements.rationale: A committed render is only trustworthy while something reports one that has fallen behind the artifacts.

criteria.condition: the verdict is taken on a package the library read from disk, and the package directory holds no spec.md
criteria.action: report one warning under the rule rendered
criteria.contract: one warning entry with check "rendered" and artifact "spec.md", whose message says spec.md is missing and names the call speca <package> --render; the verdict's valid is not changed by it

setup: a valid package on disk, loaded by the library, run once with no spec.md and once with a spec.md equal to its render, in each of the five lifecycle statuses
check.pseudocode: table in afspec/validate_test.go: for each (status, spec.md state) — prepare dir, s = LoadSpec(dir), v = s.Validate(); assert the entries with Check == "rendered" are what the case expects; assert v.Valid stays true

criteria.condition: the verdict is taken on a package the library read from disk whose spec.md differs from the package's render and the package's status is draft or active
criteria.action: report one error under the rule rendered
criteria.contract: one error entry with check "rendered" and artifact "spec.md", whose message names the number of the first line that differs and the call speca <package> --render; the verdict's valid is false

setup: a valid package on disk whose spec.md has had one line changed, at a known line number, in each of the five lifecycle statuses
check.pseudocode: table in afspec/validate_test.go: for each status — write spec.md with line N replaced; s = LoadSpec(dir); v = s.Validate(); assert the rendered entry is in v.Errors or v.Warnings as the case expects; assert its message contains fmt.Sprint(N) and "--render"; assert v.Valid == case.valid

criteria.condition: the verdict is taken on a package the library read from disk whose spec.md differs from the package's render and the package's status is sealed, superseded or archived
criteria.action: report the difference as one warning under the rule rendered rather than as an error
criteria.contract: one warning entry with check "rendered" and artifact "spec.md", naming the first line that differs and the call speca <package> --render; the verdict's valid is not changed by it

criteria.condition: the verdict is taken on a package whose spec.md is byte-identical to the package's render
criteria.action: report neither an error nor a warning under the rule rendered
criteria.contract: no entry with check "rendered" is in the verdict's errors or warnings, whatever the package's status

criteria.action: for any package the library did not read from disk, including one a dry run holds in memory with its directory set to a path it never wrote, report nothing under the rule rendered
criteria.contract: no entry with check "rendered" is in the verdict's errors or warnings, whether that directory is missing, empty or holds another package's spec.md

setup: a package built in memory, its directory field set in turn to a path that does not exist, to an empty directory, and to a directory holding another package's spec.md
check.pseudocode: table in afspec/validate_test.go: s = fixtureSpecInMemory(); s.Dir = case.dir; v = s.Validate(); assert no entry with Check == "rendered"; this is the dry-run case of specgen/pipeline.go, which sets Dir on a package it never wrote

criteria.condition: a spec.md is in the package directory and cannot be read
criteria.action: report it as a difference rather than as absent, naming why it could not be read
criteria.contract: one entry with check "rendered" whose message carries the reason the read failed; the entry is an error for a draft or active package and a warning for a sealed, superseded or archived one, as 15-REQ-2.2 and 15-REQ-2.3 say

setup: a valid package on disk whose spec.md exists with its read permission removed, run once as a draft and once as sealed
check.pseudocode: in afspec/validate_test.go: write spec.md, chmod(path, 0o000) and skip when the test runs as root; s = LoadSpec(dir); v = s.Validate(); assert the rendered entry is where the status puts it and its message carries the permission error

criteria.condition: speca <package> --status active is run on a draft package whose spec.md differs from its render, without --force
criteria.action: refuse the activation and write nothing
criteria.contract: exit code 1, stage "validate", the refused rules include "rendered", the message names the call speca <package> --render, and the status in the package's prd.md is still draft

setup: a draft package that validates on every other rule, whose spec.md differs from its render
check.pseudocode: in cmd/speca/status_test.go, beside the other activation refusals: code = Main(["--dir", root, "15", "--status", "active"], &out, &err); assert code == 1; env = decode(out); assert env.error.stage == "validate" and "rendered" in env.error.message; assert frontmatter(dir).status == "draft"

requirements.title: Rendering one package with speca --render
requirements.rationale: A render that has fallen behind, or one a package written before this change never had, is repaired by one call that changes nothing else.

criteria.condition: speca <package> --render is run on a package, whatever its lifecycle status
criteria.action: write that package's spec.md and change no other file
criteria.contract: exit code 0; spec.md holds the package's render; prd.md, requirements.json, test_spec.json, tasks.json and architecture.md are byte-identical to before the call, so the updated_at in prd.md is unchanged

setup: one package on disk in each of the five lifecycle statuses, each with no spec.md and then with a spec.md that differs from its render
check.pseudocode: table in cmd/speca/render_test.go: for each status and each starting state — before = hashEveryFileExcept(dir, "spec.md"); code = Main(["--dir", root, ref, "--render"], &out, &err); assert code == 0; assert decode(out).result.rendered == [{spec_dir: ..., rendered: "written"}]; assert readFile(dir+"/spec.md") == renderedBytes(dir); assert hashEveryFileExcept(dir, "spec.md") == before

criteria.condition: the named package's spec.md is already byte-identical to its render
criteria.action: report the package as unchanged and leave the file's bytes as they are
criteria.contract: result.rendered holds one entry for the package with rendered "unchanged"; exit code 0; the file's bytes are the same before and after the call

setup: one package on disk whose spec.md is byte-identical to its render
check.pseudocode: in cmd/speca/render_test.go: run --render once to make the file; stat and hash it; run --render again twice; assert result.rendered[0].rendered == "unchanged" each time; assert the hash and the ModTime are unchanged; assert no glob match dir+"/*.tmp.*"

criteria.condition: the named package's spec.md was absent or differed from its render
criteria.action: report the package as written
criteria.contract: result.rendered holds one entry for the package with rendered "written"; exit code 0; spec.md is then byte-identical to the package's render

criteria.condition: --dry-run is given with --render
criteria.action: report for every package what the call would change and write nothing
criteria.contract: result.dry_run is true; each entry's rendered is "written" or "unchanged" as it would have been; exit code 0; and no file in any package directory is created, changed or removed, spec.md included

setup: a spec root holding three packages: one with no spec.md, one whose spec.md is current, and one whose spec.md differs
check.pseudocode: in cmd/speca/render_test.go: before = hashEveryFileUnder(specsDir); code = Main(["--dir", root, "--render", "--dry-run"], &out, &err); assert code == 0; env = decode(out); assert env.result.dry_run == true; assert the three entries' rendered values; assert hashEveryFileUnder(specsDir) == before

criteria.condition: the one package named by the call cannot be loaded
criteria.action: fail the call and write nothing
criteria.contract: exit code 1, stage "load", the message names the package directory and the library's reason, and no file is written

setup: a package whose requirements.json is not valid JSON, and a valid package whose directory is not writable
check.pseudocode: table in cmd/speca/render_test.go, beside the two failure cases of the other forms: for each case — before = hashEveryFileUnder(dir); code = Main(["--dir", root, ref, "--render"], &out, &err); assert code == 1; assert decode(out).error.stage == case.stage; assert hashEveryFileUnder(dir) == before

criteria.condition: spec.md cannot be written for the one package named by the call
criteria.action: fail the call and leave the package as it was
criteria.contract: exit code 1, stage "write", the message names the path and why the write failed, and every other file of the package is byte-identical to before the call

requirements.title: Rendering every package with speca --render
requirements.rationale: A change to the renderer makes every committed render stale at once, and one call has to repair them all.

criteria.condition: speca --render is run with no package reference
criteria.action: render every package under the spec root, in the order of their numbers
criteria.contract: result.rendered holds one entry per package of the spec root, in number order, each with its spec_dir and its rendered outcome; exit code 0

setup: a spec root holding three packages in number order and an archive/ holding two more, none of them with a spec.md
check.pseudocode: in cmd/speca/render_test.go, following the shape of the --list tests: code = Main(["--dir", root, "--render"], &out, &err); entries = decode(out).result.rendered; assert the spec_dir values are the three in number order; then run with --all and assert the five, with Archived set on the last two

criteria.condition: speca --render is run with no package reference and --all is given
criteria.action: also render the packages under archive/, after those of the spec root
criteria.contract: the entries of the spec root come first in number order, then the archived ones in number order, each archived entry carrying archived true; exit code 0

criteria.condition: a package of the sweep cannot be loaded, or its spec.md cannot be written
criteria.action: report that package as failed with the reason, and render every other package of the sweep all the same
criteria.contract: that package's entry has rendered "failed" and a reason naming why; every other entry is "written" or "unchanged" and its spec.md is on disk; exit code 0

setup: a spec root holding four packages, of which one has a prd.md the library refuses and one has a directory that is not writable
check.pseudocode: in cmd/speca/render_test.go: break one package's prd.md and chmod another's directory to 0o500, skipping when the test runs as root; code = Main(["--dir", root, "--render"], &out, &err); assert code == 0; assert the four entries' rendered values and that the two failed ones carry a reason

criteria.condition: the spec root the sweep would read is missing, is not a directory or cannot be read
criteria.action: fail the call and write nothing
criteria.contract: exit code 1, stage "load", the message names the spec root, the fix hint names the flag --specs-dir and the environment variable AF_SPEC_DIR, and no file is written

setup: a --specs-dir naming a path that does not exist, a --specs-dir naming a regular file, and an existing but empty spec root
check.pseudocode: table in cmd/speca/render_test.go, beside the matching --list case: for each case — code = Main(["--dir", root, "--specs-dir", case.dir, "--render"], &out, &err); assert code == case.code; for the failures assert error.stage == "load" and the fix hint's flag and env; for the empty root assert the raw JSON holds "rendered":[]

criteria.condition: a call of the --render form has run
criteria.action: say in the envelope's summary sentence how many packages were written, how many were unchanged and how many failed
criteria.contract: the summary sentence carries the three counts, and they add up to the number of entries in result.rendered

setup: a spec root holding four packages: one with no spec.md, one current, one stale, and one the library refuses
check.pseudocode: in cmd/speca/render_test.go: env = decode(out); assert env.summary names the three counts; assert written + unchanged + failed == len(env.result.rendered)

criteria.condition: the spec root the sweep reads holds no package
criteria.action: report an empty list rather than failing the call
criteria.contract: result.rendered is the empty list, written as [], and exit code 0

requirements.title: --render is a form of its own
requirements.rationale: A flag that silently does nothing, or two operations in one call, is the kind of invocation a script gets wrong once and never notices.

criteria.condition: --render is given together with --validate, with --list, with the task form (--task or --state) or with the status form (--status or --by)
criteria.action: refuse the call as a usage error before anything is read or written, naming the two operations
criteria.contract: exit code 2, stage "usage", the message names --render and the other operation and says to give one, and no package and no spec root is read

setup: a spec root that would answer every form, so that a refusal cannot be the spec root's fault
check.pseudocode: table in cmd/speca/main_test.go, extending TestUsageErrors and TestUsageErrors_AcceptEveryWellFormedTaskCall: for each argv — before = hashEveryFileUnder(root); code = Main(argv, &out, &err); assert code == case.code; assert decode(out).error.message contains case.says; assert hashEveryFileUnder(root) == before

criteria.condition: --render is given with --dry-run, with --all and no package reference, or with both
criteria.action: accept the call and run the form
criteria.contract: exit code 0 and no usage error: neither the refusal of --all without --list nor the refusal of --dry-run without the task or status form is raised

criteria.condition: --force is given with --render
criteria.action: refuse the call as a usage error before anything is read
criteria.contract: exit code 2, stage "usage", the message says --force has no effect with --render, and nothing is read or written

criteria.condition: --all is given with --render and a package reference
criteria.action: refuse the call as a usage error before anything is read, saying that --all adds the archive to the sweep and means nothing for one package
criteria.contract: exit code 2, stage "usage", and nothing is read or written

criteria.condition: speca --schema is run
criteria.action: describe the --render flag among the flags, and the list the form fills among the result's fields
criteria.contract: the flags object of the printed document holds an entry named render, and the result schema holds rendered, whose entries carry spec_dir, rendered and reason

setup: nothing read from disk: --schema describes the command from its flag set and its Go types
check.pseudocode: in cmd/speca/schema_test.go, extending TestSchema_DescribesTheFormsFlagsAndResult and regenerating the golden file of TestSchema_MatchesTheGoldenFile: doc = decode(stdout of Main(["--schema"])); assert doc.flags["render"] exists; assert doc.result properties hold "rendered" with those three fields

execution_paths.title: An agent activates a draft package and the render is written with it

steps.action: runs speca <package> --status active on a draft package whose spec.md matches its render
takes the package's own verdict, the rendered rule among its rules, and finds nothing to refuse
computes the intent hash, writes prd.md, the three JSON artifacts and spec.md to temporary files, and renames them all
reads spec.md and finds the render of the activated package, carrying its new status and its intent hash

real_components: the afspec library's Transition and its atomic write
a real spec root on the file system
setup: a real spec root holding a draft package that validates, with a spec.md equal to its render
end_state: the call exits 0 and reports the status change from draft to active
the directory holds spec.md whose bytes equal the render of the activated package
spec.md carries the new status and the intent hash the activation computed
no file matching *.tmp.* is left in the directory
smoke.pseudocode: end-to-end case in cmd/speca/e2e_test.go, beside TestAnAgentFollowsNextFromTheReportToTheFinishedTask: copy a fixture package into a real temp spec root, render it, activate it through Main, then read spec.md from disk and assert it holds "Status:** active" and the hash from the frontmatter

execution_paths.title: An agent is told its render is stale and repairs it with one call

steps.action: edits requirements.json of a draft package by hand, so that spec.md no longer matches the render
reports an error under the rule rendered, naming the first line that differs and the call that repairs it
writes spec.md, reports the package as written, and leaves every other file of it untouched
runs speca <package> --validate again and the verdict holds no rendered finding

real_components: the afspec library's validation and render
a real spec root on the file system
setup: a real spec root holding a draft package whose spec.md is current
end_state: the first verdict is not valid and names the rendered rule, the first line that differs and the repairing call
the render call exits 0, reports the package written, and changes no other file of it
the second verdict holds no finding whose check is rendered and is valid
smoke.pseudocode: end-to-end case in cmd/speca/e2e_test.go: edit a title in requirements.json; v1 = decode(Main([ref, "--validate"])); assert "rendered" in rules(v1); Main([ref, "--render"]); v2 = decode(Main([ref, "--validate"])); assert v2.result.valid and no rendered finding

execution_paths.title: A maintainer brings every committed render up to date after a renderer change

steps.action: runs speca --render --all --dry-run and reads which packages would change
loads every package of the spec root and of archive/, compares each spec.md with its render, and reports each as written or unchanged without writing a file
writes each package's spec.md, reports each as written, unchanged or failed with its reason, and counts the three in the summary sentence
reads the working tree and finds that only spec.md files changed

real_components: a real spec root with an archive/ on the file system
setup: a real spec root holding three packages and an archive/ holding one, their spec.md files written by an earlier, different render
end_state: the dry run reports every package that would change and writes no file
the real call exits 0, reports each package as written, unchanged or failed, and counts the three in the summary sentence
after it every package of the spec root and of archive/ holds a spec.md equal to its render
no file of any package other than spec.md changed between the two calls
smoke.pseudocode: end-to-end case in cmd/speca/e2e_test.go: write a stale spec.md into each package; before = hashEveryFileUnder(specsDir); Main(["--render", "--all", "--dry-run"]); assert hashEveryFileUnder(specsDir) == before; Main(["--render", "--all"]); for each package assert readFile(spec.md) == renderedBytes(package); assert the only paths whose hash changed are the spec.md files
